overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Connecticut women's basketball team for winning the 2025 NCAA Division I national championship, beating the University of South Carolina 82 to 59 on April 6, 2025. It notes that this was the team's twelfth national title, the most of any school in Division I men's or women's basketball, and highlights record-setting performances by several players and the coaching staff. It also asks the Secretary of the Senate to send copies to the university president and the team's coaches. The resolution is purely ceremonial. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 1, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution properly honors a historic championship and the athletes and coaches behind it.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
